decisions.quote: Fuel products must always be the first products in the segment.
decisions.assessment: ATL105 product ordering and Petroleum fleet fuel/maintenance category restrictions constrain different properties; allowed-category restrictions do not establish ordering.

decisions.quote: For EV charging transactions, the EV fuel product code should be the first product code in the segment.
decisions.assessment: The retained Petroleum product rules do not state this EV-specific ordering proposition. This bounded finding does not prove that no EV-related rule exists elsewhere.

decisions.quote: A unique Product Code must be sent for each type of fuel purchase.
decisions.assessment: Voyager's fuel-type uniqueness is closely related; Visa's uniqueness covers product codes more broadly. Preserve each source condition and do not infer a Visa all-product extension into ATL105.

decisions.quote: Any product in these tables should be represented in messages to BUYPASS by the Product Code assigned to it in the following tables.
decisions.assessment: ATL105 Appendix F assigned-code representation and Petroleum Appendix B membership are different authorities. Shared code identity does not establish description equivalence or transaction permission.

decisions.quote: must ensure to send the primary fuel (fuel used for the primary fuel need of the truck/vehicle) as the very first product code within the Product segment.
decisions.assessment: ATL105's OTR primary-fuel ordering is not established by Petroleum fuel/maintenance restriction categories; no ordering equivalence is inferred.

decisions.quote: Discounts and coupons are applied first to nonfuel purchase amounts.
decisions.assessment: ATL105 discount allocation order and Petroleum product-presence/amount-sum reconciliation are distinct predicates; sum reconciliation does not establish allocation order.

decisions.quote: The amount of the discount in a Financial Transaction Request is included in the Product Code Data Segment, Segment No. 102 using Product Code 941 or 991.
decisions.assessment: ATL105 Host Discount's codes and pre-pay/post-pay meanings are context-specific; Petroleum Appendix B membership neither supplies nor overrides that behavior.

decisions.quote: Note: This segment does not allow any product codes above ‘899’ except for ‘955’ Cash Back. If any of these product codes is present, the transaction will be declined.
decisions.assessment: The Segment 157 value cap and 955 exception are separate acceptance conditions from Petroleum's product catalog and fleet restriction categories. Catalog presence does not imply Segment 157 acceptance.

boundaries: A named relation is not an automatic merge, denominator change, card permission, or execution result.
An empty target list is limited to the retained companion rules in this review and is not proof of global absence.
This file does not complete Petroleum-to-all-legacy review, exhaustive cross-legacy review, or whole-spec obligation derivation.
